note: No queryable zoning district layer found for Dallas County, AL. County zoning is not published as a service (county may not zone; the DUAS Land Use Map and Dallas_County_ETJ service hold land use/ETJ/boundaries only). The City of Selma, the largest city, publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (SELMA-ZONING-MAP-Model.pdf), and its zoning code is on Municode text. No ArcGIS, WFS or open-data zoning layer found for Selma or other county municipalities.
